headline: An AI researcher working on <mark>multimodal generative models</mark> 🧑‍🔬
paragraphs: I study how to generate music and images from text in a controllable way. My co-first-author work MIDILM was accepted to the AAAI 2026 Main Track, and my first-author work PixTention was published in Image and Vision Computing (IF 4.7). This line of work has produced 6 papers, 3 patent applications, and 1 registered software copyright. I focus on PEFT methods such as LoRA and P-Tuning v2 to move large models with small updates, and I serve as a reviewer for EAAI and TCSVT. My team was selected as a top-100 team (of 630) in the AI Champion Program.

Outside research, I 🎤sing and play the 🎸guitar and 🥁drums in a band. Loving music naturally led me to text-to-MIDI research. I believe in the power of steady habits, I enjoy 🍲eating, 🌅seeing, and 🎧listening to good things with good people, and I keep working on communication for better teamwork.
